cameraInstructions: Film from the front with the full body, both feet, elbows, and wrists visible. Use basic two-foot jumps.

metrics.targetText: Keep the upper body within 10 degrees of upright.
metrics.hint_good: Your upper body stayed tall during the jumps.
metrics.hint_high: Your body leaned or swung. Make the jump smaller and gently brace your core.

metrics.targetText: Keep both elbows comfortably near the sides of your body.
metrics.hint_good: Your elbows stayed close to your sides.
metrics.hint_high: Your elbows opened too wide. Bring the arms closer to your body.

metrics.targetText: Lift both feet to nearly the same height.
metrics.hint_good: Both feet left the floor together.
metrics.hint_high: One foot lifted higher than the other. Try to take off and land with both feet together.

metrics.targetText: Use a light jump about 4-18% of leg length.
metrics.hint_good: Your jump height was light and controlled.
metrics.hint_low: Jump just a little higher so both feet clearly leave the floor.
metrics.hint_high: The jumps were higher than needed. Stay low and use quick, light jumps.

metrics.targetText: Make each jump about the same height.
metrics.hint_good: Your jumps stayed at a similar height.
metrics.hint_high: Some jumps were high and others were low. Keep each jump small and even.

metrics.targetText: Keep an even rhythm from one jump to the next.
metrics.hint_good: Your jumps followed a steady beat.
metrics.hint_high: The rhythm changed between jumps. Keep a simple, even bounce.
